scope: Round 8. Customer UI redesign from the 'Auction Mockups' design file (turns 1-3: 1a Browse, 1b Lot detail, 2a Dashboard, 3a Bid history, 3b Credit). Each page is split into one feature per function, so a page with several functions has several numbered features (ui-<page>.<n>). This round restyles and extends pages that already exist (Home, AuctionDetail, Dashboard, MyBiddings, Credit). It keeps every business rule from rounds 1-7 (archived in progress-feature-list/): bids are checked against available credit and the increment ladder, top-ups and withdrawals are staff-approved requests, the transaction search window is unchanged, all deletes are soft. Staff and admin pages are out of scope except for the shared top bar and design tokens.

source_design.file: Auction Mockups.dc.html (shared in the session of 2026-10-23, not checked in)

pages.1a: Browse: category chip bar, 'Trending lots' header + sort, 4-column auction cards with your-bid strip and Bid / Custom bid buttons
pages.1b: Lot detail: breadcrumb, gallery, info card with facts grid; sticky bid panel (countdown, highest bid, % since start, price chart, input + quick bids, Place bid) and live bid history
pages.2a: Dashboard: available / locked / third summary card, Goods owned list with Sell, My auctions table with Bidding / Selling / Ended tabs

pages.3b: Credit: available-credit card, Top up / Withdraw segmented form with quick amounts, transactions panel with search, type chips and date range

conventions.tests: Playwright e2e specs go in e2e/ as <id>-<slug>.spec.ts (id with the dot replaced by a dash, e.g. e2e/ui-1a-2-browse-filters.spec.ts). API/integration tests use vitest in be/tests/ as <area>.<topic>.test.ts; frontend unit tests sit next to the code (fe/src/**/*.test.ts). fe vitest has no DOM: keep logic (formatting, filtering, chart points, status mapping) in plain modules and cover the React wiring in e2e.
conventions.existing_tests: Existing specs depend on data-testids (current-price, bid-count, next-min-bid, my-bids, my-status, credit-balance, credit-held, dashboard-credit, dashboard-locked, pending-requests, tx-empty, auction-card-<id>, section-<id>, ...). A redesign keeps those testids on the equivalent element. When a feature changes visible text or structure that an older spec checks, update the spec to check the new UI. Do not delete or weaken it.
conventions.change_docs: Each feature writes docs/changes/<id>.md listing the files it added or changed and why. ui-0.1 adds docs/design-system.md (tokens, components, how pages use them); later features add to it when they introduce a reusable component.
conventions.responsive: Mockups are drawn at 1440px. Every redesigned page must also work at 375px wide with no horizontal page scroll: grids collapse to one column, tables scroll inside their own wrapper. Each e2e spec checks at least one page at 375px.
conventions.accessibility: Clickable mockup <div>s become <button> or <a>. Tabs use role=tablist/tab with aria-selected. Status pills carry text, not colour alone. Contrast of text on the token colours must meet WCAG AA.
conventions.no_fake_data: Mockup values with no source in the system (payment card 'Visa •• 4412', '214 watching', '5% buyer's premium', 'Verified authentic', 'Meridian Horology 4.9 ★ 312 sales') are not built as static text. Each feature's notes say what replaces them.
conventions.run_all: ./init.sh (npm install + npm run verify = vitest + fe build + Playwright) must exit 0 before a feature moves to passing. Stop running Docker containers / dev servers first (CLAUDE.md), otherwise prisma generate hits EPERM.

status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task.
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.
status_legend.passing: Required verification has passed and evidence is recorded.

features.user_visible_behavior: The left column shows a navy card with available credit and 'Locked in bids $X', and below it one form with a Top up / Withdraw switch, a large '$' amount input, quick amounts ($500, $1,000, $5,000, $10,000), and a submit button that reads 'Request top up $X' (navy) or 'Request withdrawal $X' (crimson). Withdrawals over available credit are refused inline. After submitting, the request appears in a 'Waiting for approval' list under the form, and the balance changes only when staff approve (the user gets the existing stf-010 toast).
acceptance: Uses the existing request endpoints and rules unchanged (amount format, withdraw <= available, staff approval).
?mode=topup|withdraw selects the tab (ui-2a.1 links).
Inline messages: 'Enter an amount.', 'Exceeds available credit of $X.', and server 400 messages as-is.
Pending requests list keeps data-testids pending-requests / pending-<id> / no-pending; credit-balance and credit-held keep their testids.
Note under the button: 'Requests are approved by staff · top-ups are simulated, no real payment is taken.'
Two-column layout (420px | table) at >=1100px, stacked below.
verification: e2e/ui-3b-1-credit-form.spec.ts: quick amount fills input; top-up request appears pending, balance unchanged until staff approves (second context) then updates live; withdraw over available refused; ?mode=withdraw opens Withdraw
Existing crd-* specs still pass (updated for new labels only)
docs/changes/ui-3b.1.md
features.notes: The mockup credits the balance instantly and shows 'Pay with Visa •• 4412' / '1-2 business days'. The system has no payment methods and every top-up/withdrawal is a staff-approved request (stf-007), so the button says 'Request', no card row is shown, and the balance waits for approval.

features.srs_ref: Auction Mockups 3b: Transactions panel (search, type chips, date range, balance column)
features.title: Credit: transactions panel with one search box, type chips, date range and running balance
features.user_visible_behavior: The right column lists transactions with date, description (with the transaction ID under it), a type pill, a signed and coloured amount (+ steel, - crimson) and the balance after it. One search box matches lot name, transaction ID or amount; chips filter by type (All, Top up, Withdraw, Hold, Release, Purchase, Sale, Adjustment); a date-range dropdown offers the allowed preset ranges plus custom dates. Pagination stays.
acceptance: transactionFilterSchema gains optional type (list of the existing transaction types) and q (a single text that matches name, id when numeric, or amount when numeric); existing name/id/min/max params keep working for other callers (staff list stf-008).
Date presets never exceed the existing search window (SEARCH_WINDOW_DAYS); the preset labels are derived from it, not hard-coded to 90 days.
Balance column = balanceAfter; amount sign from the existing debit/credit logic (adjustments included).
Type pill labels come from one map shared with TransactionTable.
Keeps data-testid tx-empty and the existing server-error display for invalid filters.
Pending requests are not in this list (they are in ui-3b.1).
verification: be/tests/credit.transactions-q.test.ts: q by name, id, amount; type filter; combined with dates; window still enforced; old params unchanged
